import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static List<Long> getAllDivisors(long n) {
        Set<Long> divisorsSet = new HashSet<>();
        long counter = 1;
        while (counter * counter <= n) {
            if (n % counter == 0) {
                divisorsSet.add(counter);
                divisorsSet.add(n / counter);
            }
            counter++;
        }
        List<Long> divisorsList = new ArrayList<>(divisorsSet);
        Collections.sort(divisorsList);
        return divisorsList;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        final long MODULUS = 1000000007;
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] inputLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long p_value = Long.parseLong(inputLine[0]);
        long k_value = Long.parseLong(inputLine[1]);

        if (k_value == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(p_value, p_value - 1, MODULUS));
        } else if (k_value == 1) {
            System.out.println(powMod(p_value, p_value, MODULUS));
        } else {
            for (Long candidateDivisor : getAllDivisors(p_value - 1)) {
                if ((p_value - 1) % candidateDivisor == 0 && powMod(k_value, candidateDivisor, p_value) == 1) {
                    System.out.println(powMod(p_value, (p_value - 1) / candidateDivisor, MODULUS));
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long baseMod = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * baseMod) % mod;
            }
            baseMod = (baseMod * baseMod) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
